title: SpellCore Focus: First Steps
summary: Craft the Signal Focus and learn starter spell selection before fighting with magic.

blocks.title: Craft The Focus
blocks.body: Start with the Signal Focus. It is the first reliable handle for active spellcasting in this slice.

blocks.title: Carry The Core
blocks.body: When RitualCore is loaded, survival casting expects an awakened spell core in inventory. Check that before blaming the spell.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A clean first cast selects Signal Pulse, pays the cost, respects cooldown, and gives readable feedback on nearby targets.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
